name: Fall of Hell
desc:
⚠️ Increase your graphics settings if obstacles go invisible

This game is inspired by The Dropper and Tower of Hell

UPDATE V1.2 RELEASE NOTES:
🗺️ Change difficulty of the map to your liking
📷 Spectate others
🌟 Global leaderboards have been added
🧱 Some obstacles have been tweaked
🐛 Bug fixes

Welcome to the torturous game called Fall of Hell! Dive down a hole and try to reach the end without dying. It's harder than it sounds so beware and good luck, you'll need it >:D

Items bought in-game are only available in this game
